title: The Narrative Spine
subtitle: Twelve laws beneath four stories. The physics of a world.
description: The 72 equations from the earliest artifact collapse into 12 behavioral laws that operate beneath every narrative. The characters do not follow the equations. The characters are the equations made visible.

mappings.hakaka: Shared hunger, predator threat. Nights guarding together. Fish divided, meat shared.
mappings.ashwater: Infrastructure failure, Halden's pressure. Years of practiced pauses. Tea shared, labor divided.
mappings.kinderbuch: Cold, hunger, being small. Repetition of care-acts. Grass shared, knots gifted.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Wound exposure at the terminal. The system holding over time. Pattern density redistributed.

mappings.hakaka: Fish catch, hunt yield. Smoke-cure, clay seal. Mouths to feed.
mappings.ashwater: Water pressure, supply deliveries. Reservoir, pantry during blackout.
mappings.kinderbuch: Berries found, warmth gathered. Knots that hold things.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Pattern input from donors. 1,100 anomalies, 3,333 proverbs stored.

mappings.hakaka: Star position, wind direction. Basalt ridge, known water sources.
mappings.ashwater: Contact microphone readings. Known infrastructure states. Laila's years of experience.
mappings.kinderbuch: Golden sparks showing the way. Recognizing what was seen before.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Pattern match strength. Canonical reference points. Input ledger history.

mappings.hakaka: Hanu's footfall null. Scent control near predators. Mud, ash, terrain that absorbs.
mappings.ashwater: Analog hour — cutting digital signals. Kite signals over radio silence.
mappings.kinderbuch: Being quiet, tiptoeing. Holding breath when scared.
mappings.kalaxi_1: k≥7 anonymization. The system does not expose donor identity.

mappings.hakaka: Throwing lever torque. Ma'da's aim. Pack hunting together.
mappings.ashwater: Analog tools — kites, contact mics. Laila's precision of reading.
mappings.kinderbuch: The knot that reaches far. Throwing accurately.
mappings.kalaxi_1: The terminal's question design. System calibration.

mappings.hakaka: Simo's pattern spotting. Ya-la watching how eddies braid.
mappings.ashwater: Salim's ear to vents. 'Trust the flaw. Real signals have seams.'
mappings.kinderbuch: Noticing the golden sparks. Something that doesn't feel right.

mappings.hakaka: Clan bonds. Shared meat, traded tools. When to speak, when to hold.
mappings.ashwater: City alliances. Ruqayya's tea. The three-beat pause.
mappings.kinderbuch: Who is friends. Sharing warmth. Taking turns, waiting.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Donor network. Pattern contribution. The cursor waiting.

strata.law: Protection and heat retention under exposure

mappings.hakaka: Hide coat, cave walls. Smoke oil, stitch tight.
mappings.ashwater: Building integrity, wall panels. Institutional resilience.
mappings.kinderbuch: The knot that holds against cold. Golden sparks as inner warmth.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Sealed gate, privacy budget. k≥7 anonymization.

mappings.ashwater: Contact microphone on structure. Laila's three-beat code.
mappings.kinderbuch: Voice in the dark. Simple words, repeated.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Terminal screen clarity. Question design. The cursor's quality of not-responding.

mappings.hakaka: Drought drying water. North-spine vs fire-veil vs wet-step.
mappings.ashwater: Halden strangling supply lines. Analog vs digital routes.
mappings.kinderbuch: Winter coming, food gone. Scary path vs safe path.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Not yet activated. The system is stationary.

mappings.hakaka: Red-thread rite knots. Clan witnesses at binding. Bloodless bargain.
mappings.ashwater: Protocols written on walls. Rashid admitting 'the world doesn't live in models.'
mappings.kinderbuch: Trying again, making another knot. Not giving up.
mappings.kalaxi_1: The system's own witness network. Holding without solving. The Girl as permanent unresolved harm.

strata.name: Release
strata.law: Tension regulation through humor and play

mappings.hakaka: Counting fish wrong and laughing at the river. Mud-seed naming. Rain-drip sneeze.
mappings.ashwater: Brochures steadying a wobbly table leg. Ruqayya's tray not trembling scared her.
mappings.kinderbuch: Golden sparks playing tricks. Small mishaps becoming warmth.
mappings.kalaxi_1: Not yet activated. No humor scene exists. This absence is itself a signal.
